description: This file contains unit tests for the ConceptValidator class in the OpenMRS project, verifying validation logic for Concept objects including name validation, duplicate checks, and mapping validations.

classes.name: ConceptValidatorTest
classes.description: Test suite for the ConceptValidator class, ensuring proper validation of Concept entities within the system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test case.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheObjectParameterIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that validation fails with null input.

methods.name: shouldFailIfNamesAreEmpty
methods.description: Checks validation error when concept names are empty.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheConceptDatatypeIsNull
methods.description: Ensures validation errors if concept datatype is missing.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheConceptClassIsNull
methods.description: Ensures validation errors if concept class is missing.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAnyNameIsAnEmptyString
methods.description: Checks validation errors when any concept name is an empty string.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAnyNameIsANullValue
methods.description: Checks validation errors when any concept name is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfThereIsADuplicateUnretiredConceptNameInTheLocale
methods.description: Verifies that duplicate active concept names in the same locale trigger a duplicate exception.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAnyNamesInTheSameLocaleForThisConceptAreSimilar
methods.description: Checks for duplicate names within the same concept and locale.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfThereIsADuplicateUnretiredFullySpecifiedNameInTheSameLocale
methods.description: Tests for duplicate fully specified names in the same locale.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfThereIsADuplicateUnretiredPreferredNameInTheSameLocale
methods.description: Tests for duplicate preferred names within the same locale.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfThereIsNoNameExplicitlyMarkedAsFullySpecified
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if no fully specified name exists.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfTheConceptIsBeingUpdatedWithNoNameChange
methods.description: Checks that no errors are thrown when updating without name changes.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfTheConceptHasAtleastOneFullySpecifiedNameAddedToIt
methods.description: Verifies validation passes with at least one fully specified name.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfTheDuplicateConceptNameIsNeitherPreferredNorFullySpecified
methods.description: Ensures validation accepts duplicate names that are not preferred or fully specified.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfTheConceptWithADuplicateNameIsRetired
methods.description: Checks validation passes if the concept with duplicate name is marked as retired.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfTheConceptBeingValidatedIsRetiredAndHasADuplicateName
methods.description: Verifies that a retired concept with duplicate name does not trigger an error.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfTheConceptHasASynonymThatIsAlsoAShortName
methods.description: Ensures validation passes for concepts with synonyms that are short names.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfATermIsMappedMultipleTimesToTheSameConcept
methods.description: Verifies that adding multiple identical mappings triggers an error.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfTheDuplicateNameInTheLocaleForTheConceptBeingValidatedIsVoided
methods.description: Ensures no error when a duplicate name is marked as voided.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfThereIsADuplicateUnretiredConceptNameInTheSameLocaleDifferentThanTheSystemLocale
methods.description: Checks for duplicate names in different locales triggers exception.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassForANewConceptWithAMapCreatedWithDeprecatedConceptMapMethods
methods.description: Validates proper handling of concept mapping with deprecated methods.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassForAnEditedConceptWithAMapCreatedWithDeprecatedConceptMapMethods
methods.description: Ensures validation passes with edited concept mappings.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotFailIfATermHasTwoNewMappingsOnIt
methods.description: Checks that multiple new mappings on a term do not produce errors.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Verifies that valid field lengths pass validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Checks that overly long field values produce validation errors.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfFullySpecifiedNameIsTheSameAsShortName
methods.description: Ensures validation passes if fully specified name matches short name.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfDifferentConceptsHaveTheSameShortNames
methods.description: Checks that different concepts can share the same short name without error.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfCodedConceptContainsItselfAsAnAnswer
methods.description: Verifies that a concept cannot be an answer to itself.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotFailIfAnyDescriptionIsNotEnteredWhileCreatingANewConcept
methods.description: Validates that descriptions are optional during creation.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfNoneofTheConceptDescriptionsIsNull
methods.description: Checks that null descriptions pass.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotFailIfBlankConceptDescriptionIsPassed
methods.description: Verifies that blank descriptions are ignored.

methods.name: validate_shouldSkipConceptNameValidationForRetiredConcepts
methods.description: Ensures retired concepts are exempt from name validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldSkipConceptMapValidationForRetiredConcepts
methods.description: Ensures retired concepts are exempt from concept map validation.
